vulnerability_mechanism.detail: The first-party GHSA and the 3.1.53 tree agree: Repo.clone_from(..., template=<dir>) reaches git clone, Git._option_candidates yields --template, unsafe_git_clone_options omits it, and a template can install a post-checkout hook. Submodule cloning routes through Repo.clone_from.

atomic_bic.detail: e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230 first creates the named list, but it replaces the semantically equivalent incomplete checks added in 2625ed9fc074091c531c27ffcba7902771130261. The protocol excludes a refactor from serving as the BIC. More fundamentally, clone-option forwarding existed before both commits, including Repo.clone since the root commit 33ebe7acec14b25c5f84f35a664803fcab2f7781 and Repo.clone_from since b425301ad16f265157abdaf47f7af1c1ea879068.

immediate_parent_absence.detail: The immediate parent 2625ed9fc074091c531c27ffcba7902771130261 lacks the unsafe_git_clone_options symbol but remains exploitable: _clone passes kwargs and multi_options to git.clone, while unsafe_options rejects upload-pack and selected config forms but not template. Symbol absence is not mechanism absence.

squash_member_decomposition.detail: e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230 is a single-parent member commit, followed by fd2c6da5f82009398d241dc07603fbcd490ced29, b92f01a3a38fc8e171d08575c69de9733811faa6, c8ae33b9314a7d3716827b5cb705a3cd0a2e4a46, 9dc43926207b2205d77511c6ffd40944199f0c2d, and f4f2658d5d308b3fb9162e50cd4c7b346e7a0a47 before merge 678a8fe08dd466fcfe8676294b52887955138960; it is not a squash aggregate. This decomposition does not cure the earlier semantic predecessor.

affected_fixed_release_membership.detail: e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230 is absent from 3.1.29 and present from 3.1.30 through 3.1.53. The authoritative records nevertheless mark all versions below 3.1.54 affected, consistent with pre-3.1.30 option forwarding. ffcb5359e87619f4fe4a70a4aff5f08c5580ba97 is absent from 3.1.53 and is an ancestor of 3.1.54.

direct_fix_or_unpatched.detail: Direct fix ffcb5359e87619f4fe4a70a4aff5f08c5580ba97 has parent e8d0fbf774d1f6baa3b481adfe48bd262e43b453, adds --template to unsafe_git_clone_options, and adds regression cases for both --template=<dir> and template=<dir>.

bic_only_ai_attribution.detail: The asserted e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230 object has Santos Gallegos as author and committer and no trailers or AI marker, while AI evidence is confined to the fix. But AI attribution must be made on the actual atomic BIC, which is not closed after the parent-mechanism failure.

findings: The primary conflates first creation of the current denylist data structure with first creation of the vulnerable mechanism; e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230 refactors an already incomplete default check and its immediate parent still executes attacker-selected templates.

The release evidence independently contradicts a 3.1.30-only origin: CVE-2026-73623 and the first-party GHSA cover versions below 3.1.54, while the clone API forwarded option kwargs years before the asserted BIC.
The direct fix and fixed-release boundary are verified, but they do not prove the primary introducer or permit BIC-only NOT_AI attribution.
remaining_gap: Decompose the affected Repo.clone, Repo.clone_from, and submodule paths to their true first vulnerable writers and prove immediate-parent absence for each. Until an atomic BIC set is closed, both introducer fields and BIC-only AI attribution must remain null.
